citation.authors: Day M, Bonnet K, Schlundt DG et al

cited_by.title: Sickle cell disease: what it is, treatment and newborn screening

record.population: 14 women with sickle cell disease in focus groups
record.finding: Women with sickle cell disease could tell acute sickle cell pain from menstrual cramps. Themes included effects on quality of life and emotional well-being. The authors say providers should become more familiar with sickle cell pain linked to menstruation.
